name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
ministry: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
benefit_summary: Accidental death and disability insurance cover for bank/post office account holders aged 18-70, renewable annually at a low premium
benefit_amount: Rs 2 lakh for accidental death or permanent total disability; Rs 1 lakh for permanent partial disability; annual premium Rs 20

name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
ministry: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
benefit_summary: Renewable one-year term life insurance cover for bank/post office account holders aged 18-50, covering death from any cause
benefit_amount: Rs 2 lakh life cover on death of the insured due to any cause; annual premium Rs 330

name: Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY)
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (National Health Mission)
benefit_summary: Cash assistance to pregnant women for institutional delivery to reduce maternal and infant mortality; amount varies by state performance category (LPS/HPS) and rural/urban residence
benefit_amount: Rs 1400 (LPS rural), Rs 1000 (LPS urban), Rs 700 (HPS rural), Rs 600 (HPS urban), plus ASHA facilitation incentive

name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maandhan Yojana (PM-KMY)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
benefit_summary: Voluntary and contributory pension scheme for small and marginal farmers, providing an assured minimum pension after age 60
benefit_amount: Rs 3000/month pension after age 60; 50% family pension to spouse on death of farmer; monthly contribution Rs 55-200 matched by Government

name: PM Krishi Sinchayee Yojana - Per Drop More Crop (PMKSY-PDMC)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare (in coordination with Ministry of Jal Shakti)
benefit_summary: Financial assistance for installation of micro-irrigation (drip and sprinkler) systems to improve water use efficiency at farm level
benefit_amount: 55% subsidy for small and marginal farmers, 45% subsidy for other farmers on micro-irrigation installation cost

name: Soil Health Card Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
benefit_summary: Free soil testing with crop-wise nutrient and fertilizer recommendations issued to land-holding farmers periodically to improve productivity
benefit_amount: Free of cost soil testing and advisory card, reissued approximately every 2-3 years

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare / Department of Financial Services
benefit_summary: Single-window short-term credit facility for crop cultivation and allied agricultural needs (dairy, poultry, fisheries, animal husbandry) at subsidised interest rate via a RuPay-enabled card
benefit_amount: Loan limit up to Rs 5 lakh eligible for interest subvention (effective 4% on timely repayment); collateral-free lending up to Rs 2 lakh

name: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (PKVY)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
benefit_summary: Cluster-based support for farmers to adopt organic farming, covering inputs, certification, processing and marketing end-to-end
benefit_amount: Rs 31500/hectare over 3 years per organic cluster, of which Rs 15000/hectare is direct DBT to farmers for inputs

name: National Livestock Mission
ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying (Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying)
benefit_summary: Capital subsidy support for entrepreneurship development in rural poultry, sheep/goat breeding, piggery breeding, and feed/fodder production for individuals, FPOs, SHGs, JLGs and Section 8 companies
benefit_amount: 50% capital subsidy: up to Rs 25 lakh (rural poultry), Rs 50 lakh (sheep/goat breeding farm), Rs 30 lakh (piggery breeding farm)

name: Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Pariyojana (PMBJP)
ministry: Department of Pharmaceuticals, Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers
benefit_summary: Quality generic medicines and surgical items sold at affordable prices to the public through dedicated Jan Aushadhi Kendras across the country
benefit_amount: Medicines priced 50-90% below branded market price; over 19500 Jan Aushadhi Kendras operational nationwide

name: Nikshay Poshan Yojana
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (Central TB Division)
benefit_summary: Monthly nutritional support cash transfer to all notified tuberculosis patients for the duration of their treatment under the National TB Elimination Programme
benefit_amount: Rs 1000 per month per notified TB patient, disbursed via DBT to Aadhaar-linked bank account

name: Rashtriya Arogya Nidhi (RAN)
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
benefit_summary: Financial assistance to patients from Below Poverty Line families suffering from major life-threatening diseases (heart, kidney, liver, cancer, etc.) for treatment at government super-specialty hospitals
benefit_amount: Financial assistance up to Rs 15 lakh (up to Rs 20 lakh for rare diseases)
